instruction: Look at counterbore_plate.dxf. Draw the 180 x 70 plate as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with corners at (0,0), (180,0), (180,70), and (0,70). At (45,35) and (135,35), draw simplified 2D concentric counterbore geometry without thread details: a radius 5 through-hole circle on layer HOLE and a radius 10 counterbore circle on layer CUTOUT. Add text ACAD-14 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
